subject: Offline mode is here
preheader: Write on a plane, sync when you land. No setup needed.
headline: Your notes now work without a connection
body:
Offline mode is live for everyone today. Open Larkspur on a train, a plane or in a basement café, and everything you write is saved on your device first.

When you are back online, your notes sync in the background. If you edited the same note on two devices, we keep both versions side by side so nothing is lost.

image.alt: A phone showing a note marked 'saved on this device'
